hooks.name: AI collaboration log

action.prompt:
Append a new entry to docs/ai-collaboration/session-log.md (create the folder and file if missing). Format:
## <timestamp>
**My prompt:** <my last prompt, verbatim>
**What Kiro did:** <2-3 line summary>
**Files touched:** <list>
**Decisions / pushback:** <any choice I made or correction I gave, or "none">
Never edit or delete earlier entries.

hooks.description: Captures each agent turn into docs/ai-collaboration/session-log.md so reviewers can see how I worked with Kiro.
